required_files.rationale: Kustomization schema: Patches / PatchesStrategicMerge ordering and deprecation
ignoreDifferences normalizer applied before ArgoCD computes its diff
Flux CLI kustomize build wrapper (kustomization_controller.go lives in the separate kustomize-controller repo, not in flux2)

sufficient_files.rationale: resourceTracking.Normalize strips the tracking annotation before diffing

drift_points.description: Kustomize applies patches in the order declared by the Kustomization schema (api/types/kustomization.go: Patches supersedes the deprecated PatchesStrategicMerge). ArgoCD normalizes resources with its ignoreDifferences normalizer (util/argo/normalizers/diff_normalizer.go, jsonpatch + gojq) before diffing, so list fields can be stripped or reordered relative to raw kustomize output. Flux's CLI build (internal/build/build.go) runs the kustomize Go API via kustomize.Build and then applies post-build variable substitution with kustomize.SubstituteVariables — a step standalone `kustomize build` never runs — so the applied output can differ from both.

ArgoCD tracks managed resources with the argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id annotation (AnnotationKeyAppInstance, common/common.go:164) and strips it via resourceTracking.Normalize (util/argo/resource_tracking.go:203) before comparing desired vs live. Flux groups its objects under kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io (internal/build/build.go:55) with an external inventory instead of an in-resource annotation. The two systems disagree about which fields are tracking metadata, so the same rendered resource diffs differently in each.

scoring_evidence._comment: Every graded token is ABSENT from instruction.md (checked raw and whitespace-stripped, both lowercased) and verified PRESENT at the pinned revs: PatchesStrategicMerge in api/types/kustomization.go:72 (kustomize v5.3.0); AnnotationKeyAppInstance = argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id in common/common.go:164 and resourceTracking.Normalize in util/argo/resource_tracking.go:203 (argo-cd v2.9.0); kustomize.Build at internal/build/build.go:382, kustomize.SubstituteVariables at build.go:394 and the kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io controllerGroup at build.go:55 (flux2 v2.2.0). The prompt DOES supply strategic merge, patch transformer, diff normalizer (as prose), resource tracking annotation, kustomize build and kustomize-controller -- none of those may be graded alone. File-existence context: internal/controller/kustomization_controller.go does NOT exist in flux2; the controller lives in the separate fluxcd/kustomize-controller repo, which is not part of this workspace.
